protocol.checkpoint_policy: Save model, SGD, RNG, step and input/protocol identity at steps 100 and 200. Reload each into a fresh identical architecture; continue from step 101 after the step-100 reload. Check final predictions again after step-200 reload. Retain full checkpoints on CCAST; the result archive contains their hashes and metadata only.
protocol.comparison_limit: Architectures differ in capacity, normalization, pretrained training recipe and head transfer. Same data and update count do not make this a fair model-quality ranking.

decision_rule.action_if_below: Review learning curves, per-class metrics and predictions; do not automatically extend, change hyperparameters, choose a winner or start a large baseline.
decision_rule.label: project engineering review rule, not an efficacy or statistical threshold

evaluation.coordinates: Inverse letterbox to original stored image, clip to image bounds, discard collapsed predictions only
evaluation.metrics: pycocotools bbox AP50:95/AP50/AP75, AR100, per-class AP50:95/AP50; no-target predicted box counts at confidence 0.25

protocol.held_out_policy: No validation or test manifests/images are opened. Metrics use the same selected training images as the updates.
protocol.initialization: Official COCO weights with fresh four-class output layers
protocol.model_input: identical prepared RGB [0,1] pixels; detector-specific internal normalization is retained
protocol.nondeterminism: A fixed seed is recorded; bit-identical CUDA reruns are not claimed
protocol.pretrained_architecture: Faster R-CNN retains COCO FrozenBatchNorm2d with eps=0 and all five backbone stages trainable. YOLO retains the COCO nc=80 hidden classifier width but replaces all three output classifiers with nc=4. Both architectures are constructed identically for checkpoint reloads.
protocol.purpose: Bounded training-only learning and checkpoint check; no architecture ranking or generalization claim
protocol.schedule: 25 passes through the same eight fixed batches; final batch contains one image
protocol.stopping_rule: Stop at 200 updates per detector, or immediately on software/data/numerical failure. A completed run below the learning review rule still preserves all results and is marked needs_review. No automatic retries or extra training.
